name: minions
description: Runs the main conversation on Haiku as a dispatcher that never does work itself, and routes every task to a minion on the model tier that fits it: Haiku scouts, Sonnet mappers and coders, Opus planners and analysts, Fable researchers.

orchestratorModel.title: Dispatcher model
orchestratorModel.description: The model the main conversation runs on: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

guard.title: Refuse work in the main conversation
guard.description: Deny file, shell, search and web tools to the main conversation so every task goes to a minion. Off: the routing rules are advice only.
